name: workflow-dev
description: Human-piloted, agent-executed development workflow. Bootstraps a persistent per-project context from Jira, Confluence, and GitHub via MCP — or from a local Markdown file when no issue tracker is available — then decomposes it into a task plan, executes it with enforced quality rules, and runs a multi-dimensional gate before commit. Context survives compaction and new sessions, saved explicitly on request — never automatically.
